title: Find Median from Data Stream
description:
The **median** of a list of numbers is its middle value when sorted; for an even count it is the mean of the two middle values.

Implement the `MedianFinder` class:

- `MedianFinder()` creates an empty finder.
- `addNum(num)` adds the integer `num` to the data stream.
- `findMedian()` returns the median of all numbers added so far.

Tests describe a sequence of calls as two arrays: the operation names (starting with the class name) and their arguments. The expected output has `null` for the constructor and for methods that return nothing. Answers must match exactly, so return the true median (for example `1.5`).
constraints: findMedian is only called when at least one number has been added.
hints: Keep the smaller half of the numbers in a max-heap and the larger half in a min-heap.
After every insertion, rebalance so the two heaps differ in size by at most one; the median is then at one or both tops.
